name: Review and audit
description: Perform a bounded correctness, security, and architecture review with prioritized findings and explicit limitations.

states.description: Resolve the review target, authority, depth, exclusions, and acceptance criteria.
states.stopCondition: Stop when review scope or authority remains ambiguous.

states.description: Gather repository and, when authorized, primary external evidence relevant to the review scope.
states.stopCondition: Stop when required evidence is unavailable and the limitation cannot be bounded.

states.description: Review correctness, security, and architecture at the agreed public seams.
states.stopCondition: Stop when the evidence is insufficient for a defensible finding.

states.description: Rank findings by impact, likelihood, confidence, and remediation urgency with file and line evidence.
states.stopCondition: Stop when a finding cannot be tied to evidence or a clear disposition.

states.description: Report checks that were not run, why they were unavailable, and the exact later command or owner needed.
states.stopCondition: Stop successfully only when findings, evidence, limitations, and not-run checks are explicit.

gates.requirement: The review scope and authority are explicit.
Repository and authorized external evidence are recorded with source boundaries.
Correctness, security, and architecture seams are considered.
Every finding has evidence, priority, confidence, and disposition.
Unavailable checks are explicitly marked not run with a concrete follow-up.

successCriteria: Findings are evidence-backed, prioritized, and scoped to the request.
Every unavailable check is reported as not run rather than implied to pass.
